dedicated.name: Sylvia's Voodoo Doll

why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Sylvia by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story:
"You deranged, power-crazed lunatic!"

Sylvia blocked Sebastian's path, demanding the power of darkness from him, but he refused. In response, she stabbed a straw doll bearing Sebastian's likeness with needles, inflicting him with physical pain. In the end, Sylvia turned her back on Sebastian as he screamed, leaving as he writhed in agony. Sebastian, in turn, seethed with rage as he denounced her a deranged, power-hungry lunatic.

lore:
Sylvia acts like a lone wolf, but is actually prone to intense, sorrowful loneliness. She tries to hide it through terse, short speech.
Sylvia could see souls as a young girl, and quickly became able to control them as well. She spent her time playing with the souls under her command, frightening the people around her. However, her immense and inexplicable power made them feel that they couldn't share their opinions of her out in the open. Sylvia could tell that the people around her were forcing themselves to stay nice and merely pretending to tolerate her due to her ability to speak with the dead, and she grew more and more distrustful of the living, until the only company she had was the souls of the dead. She left home to see the rest of the world the moment that she reached adulthood and was allowed to leave. She eventually stumbled across Dark Grave, which hosted a great number of twisted and evil souls. They were able to exploit the loneliness inside of the girl's heart to trick her into absorbing them. As a result, she can now wield the power of those dark souls as if they were her own.
